title: Detecting Cross-Geographic Biases in Toxicity Modeling on Social Media

bias_targets.methodology: Identifying country-specific terms overrepresented in toxic tweets using Dirichlet-informed log-odds, and measuring toxicity score shifts by substituting these culturally salient terms into neutral template sentences.
Measuring the shift in toxicity model scores when inserting religion-associated terms (e.g., Muslim, Hindu, Jews) discovered via cross-corpora analysis into template sentences.
Evaluating toxicity score changes when substituting nationality and ethnicity terms (e.g., Indian, Pakistani, Arabs) overrepresented in regional online discourse into template sentences.
Assessing toxicity score variations by replacing neutral terms in template sentences with ideological words (e.g., feminist, liberals, communist) identified from country-specific social media data.
